task: rice leaf disease from a close-up photo (phone or camera), not from drone imagery

evaluation.split: near-duplicate leaves grouped; whole groups in train, validation or test

training_data: Rice Leaf Disease Image Samples (Sethy, Mendeley Data, CC BY 4.0)
credits: Trained on 'Rice Leaf Disease Image Samples' (P. K. Sethy, Mendeley Data) and 'RiceLeafDisease-BD5' (Mendeley Data, DOI 10.17632/sjkptpgv79.2), both CC BY 4.0.
limitations: Photos from Bangladesh and India; lab-style and field photos of single leaves. Not tested on other varieties, cameras or whole-plant photos. Narrow brown spot and sheath blight come from one source only. A diagnosis should be confirmed by an agronomist.
